name: opl-flow
description: OPL Flow starts and supervises a durable task ledger, provides a model-native Codex profile, and coordinates optional Fleet execution.

interface.longDescription: OPL Flow creates or reuses one Beads-backed Dashboard and hourly supervisor, projects every user-ledger task to Linear with a narrow field set, packages a concise Codex profile, and coordinates optional Instance-backed Fleet execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $opl-flow start to reuse my ledger Dashboard, project every ledger task to Linear, and supervise hourly.
